name: Ka'el
source:
Ka'el is the cool and confident space trader who often passes through the Hesperides. Whatever you're looking for she can find, for the right price of course.

She is instantly intrigued by the station's newest arrival. Perhaps she simply sees them as a new potential customer, perhaps more...

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/330388878/love-at-the-milky-way-diner/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
